rules: Do not recursively scan image folders; query the ontology.
Never guess mxgraph stencil names; use exact style from shape search.
Treat official shapes, external SVG icons, and capability scripts as different entity classes.
For graphs larger than about 15 nodes, prefer autolayout.py.
After generation run validate.py, export a PNG, and visually inspect it.
For portable AI icons use local SVG or aiicons.py --embed.
